method.definition: Smart money = the brokers whose past net accumulation measurably beat the market, not the biggest brokers. Skill is scored on matured accumulation events (trailing 30-day net buying, outcome over the next 10 sessions vs the average stock); the board follows the top-decile cohort of skilled brokers. Nepse Decode published construction — the equivalent commercial board sells the same idea with its rows locked and its parameters undisclosed.
method.source: Nepse Decode floorsheet archive (Chukul raw floorsheet, collected daily after close, finality-gated) + OHLC archive with corporate-action-adjusted closes.
